description: One tab of a TabBar: identified by value, labelled label, shown over icon.

constructors.description: A tab for value, labelled label, shown over icon, with an optional badge.

params.name: label
params.description: The tab's label: shown in TsuyaType.micro under the icon, and read for screen readers (before badge's own meaning, when there is one).

params.name: icon
params.description: Drawn at TsuyaSize.iconLg: TsuyaColors.accent (by way of Accent.of) when current, otherwise TsuyaColors.textMuted.

params.name: badge
params.description: Pinned to the icon's corner; never read itself.
